organization: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)
description:
What we do
Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence.In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on.We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats.Purpose
 
Responsible for small to medium-sized projects under Nekemte Urban Water Supply Project and ensures their successful delivery within the constraints of scope, quality, time and budget. With some guidance, prepares, designs, procures, implements and commissions projects. Manage relationships with the stakeholders involved. Manages project resources and ensures project reporting.
 Relationships

 
Internally, interacts with the sub-delegation staff
Externally:

Interacts with local authorities, water utilities, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and communities related to the project.
Maintains professional communication with stakeholders involved in the Nekemte Urban Water Supply Project.

Accountabilities & functional responsibilities
 
Functional Responsibilities:
 
Project Planning and Design
 

Contributes to the study of the various projects under Nekemte Urban Water Supply project and understands the needs and challenges.
Contributes to assessments, surveys, and data collection required for Nekemte Urban Water Supply project planning and implementation.
Assists in identifying the needs and operational priorities for the Nekemte Urban Water Supply Project and analyzing needs through assessments and survey.
Contributes to the collection of all the information and data necessary to prepare the projects. Prepares feasibility studies/project proposals, and technical designs (specifications, drawings, BoQs, cost estimates, etc).
Contributes to the preparation and review of project documents for approval.

 
Procurement and Contract Management
 

Supports procurement processes in accordance with ICRC procedures and regulations.
Assists in the preparation of tender documents, Requests for Quotations (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Terms of Reference (ToRs), and contracts.
Actively contributes to the launch of procurement and works contracts in accordance with delegation's rules and ensures follow-up.
Follows up on procurement and contract implementation activities.
Coordinates with Logistics and Finance departments to ensure timely processing of procurement and payments.

 Accountabilities & functional responsibilities 2
 
Project Implementation and Supervision
 

Organizes and supervises construction and rehabilitation works related to the project.
Monitors contractors’ performance and ensures compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.
Supervise the work through continuous site visits and quality control inspections.
Identifies implementation challenges and proposes corrective actions in a timely manner.
Ensures that works are implemented according to approved plans, timelines, and budgets.
On a systematic and regular manner, anticipates, identifies and escalates problems that may affect all or part of the project, and proposes/implements corrective actions.

 
Reporting and Documentation
 

Prepares implementation updates, technical reports, field visit reports, and meeting minutes.
Maintains accurate and updated project files, including technical, contractual, financial, and reporting documents.
Ensures that project documentation is properly filed and shared according to WatHab procedures.
Uses approved tools and platforms for project follow-up and reporting.

 
Stakeholder Coordination
 

Contributes to the identification and collaboration with all stakeholders who may have an influence on the success of the projects.
Maintains regular communication with local authorities, water utilities, consultants, contractors, and communities.
Supports coordination meetings and technical discussions with project stakeholders.
Contributes to maintaining positive working relationships with all parties involved in the project.

 Commissioning and Handover
 

Ensures the commissioning and handover of infrastructure and equipment to the relevant parties and necessary communication and training.
Organizes or supports training sessions for end-users and operators to the "client" for the proper use of the facilities, equipment and services.
Ensures that clients and stakeholders receive the necessary technical information for operation and maintenance.
